requirements.requirement: The system shall be portable and run on Linux, Windows, and Solaris operating systems.

requirements.requirement: The system shall support responsive UI actions within five seconds for small tasks and eight seconds for heavier tasks.

requirements.requirement: The system shall handle at least 1,000 simultaneous requests and scale to handle 2,000 simultaneous requests in the next release.

requirements.requirement: The system shall achieve 99.99% uptime, excluding server-level failures.
